# In a generic partial-order object, strict comparison means non-strict
# comparison together with inequality.
prop is_less_than_in_order(A set, order \PartialOrder<A>, x, y A):
    (x, y) $in order
    x != y

thm strict_order_iff:
    ? forall A set, order \PartialOrder<A>, x, y A:
        =>:
            $is_less_than_in_order(A, order, x, y)
        <=>:
            (x, y) $in order
            x != y
